precios.titulo: You haven't added any prices yet
precios.hint: You add a price from the map's "+" or from the bar's page. It's what keeps the map alive.

fotos.titulo: You haven't uploaded any photos yet
fotos.hint: Photos go on the beer, below the price. They're shrunk on your phone before uploading.

comentarios.titulo: You haven't written any comments yet
comentarios.hint: Below each beer's photos there's a box to say how it was.

bares.titulo: You haven't added any bars yet
bares.hint: If you know one that's not on the map, add it: it's there for everyone.

precio.vigente: It's the price the app {fuerte} for {estilo} at {bar}. If you delete it, the previous report stays if there is one; if not, the bar is left without a price.
precio.viejo: It's an old report, so it doesn't change what's shown today: it leaves the history of {estilo} at {bar}.

foto.texto: The file is deleted, not just from the list. It can't be undone.

comentario.texto: Only the text is deleted. Your rating of that beer stays as it is: deleting what you wrote isn't withdrawing your vote.

baresNoSeBorran: Bars can't be deleted from here: they may have prices and photos from other people, so deleting them doesn't undo your contribution, it deletes someone else's. If one is wrong, report it from the bar.
